status: pilot (exploratory). Separate experiment from Wild Ideas pilot_v1/v2: different instruction and output format.

generator.temperature: not settable via CLI; provider default, unverified
generator.reasoning_note: Smoke test 2026-11-17: with --effort and MAX_THINKING_TOKENS the CLI returns 'thinking' blocks whose text is EMPTY (signature only). Thinking tokens are not reported separately; output_tokens includes them. On an easy creative prompt the model produced no thinking block at all (adaptive). So per call we record: number of thinking blocks, whether any thinking text was returned, total output_tokens, visible text length. Hidden reasoning content is not available and is never reconstructed.

nodedup_split.note: Same total ceiling as one structured call (4 x 2000 thinking, 4 x 4000 output). Each call sees no other candidate; no review, no selection, no de-duplication. Final = seeded random pick among the 4.

bucketer.note: temperature not supported by this model (HTTP 400, 2026-11-17); 'low' is the lowest reasoning effort accepted

embedding.note: retrieval of candidate buckets only; MuseScorer's best was e5-large-v2 (not cached here)

gpt-6-astra.source: third-party aggregators (morphllm, cloudzero, aitokenprice), checked 2026-11-17; not OpenAI's own page

provisional_topics_note: PLACEHOLDER. The research design says the human supplies the brand topic/keyword. These were chosen by Claude for the pilot only and assigned to brands by seed. Replace with researcher-supplied topics for the main run.
